verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents an official GitHub Action as the recommended way to put the Blaxel CLI into a CI pipeline. Long-lived API keys work across the APIs, CLI and SDK for non-interactive authentication. An official CLI reference and SDK/REST access to sandboxes provide programmatic, headless operation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and detail on the GitHub Action's configuration and non-interactive CLI behavior (flags, output formats).
